case_name: Heimkes v. Fairhope Motorcoach Resort Condominium Owners Association, Inc.
summary: Relied on Chevron deference despite Loper Bright; court found the filing misrepresented the status of the law.
outcome: Reprimand; order to file order in subsequent cases; bar referral; adverse costs order

case_name: Elbert Coleman, III; Elbert Coleman, IV v. Nexo Capital Inc.
summary: Plaintiffs cited Indiana Code section 23-2-1-2 for a securities proposition; the court found the statute had been repealed.

case_name: Arkansas DHS v. April Ward and Minor Child Respondents
summary: A brief relied on statutory text without noting that the statute had changed; the current text did not support the proposition.
outcome: Report to Office of Professional Conduct and counsel dismissal

case_name: Health Care Complaints Commission v Campbell
summary: Submission cited section 3(3)(c) of the National Law; the tribunal noted the provision had been repealed.

case_name: XAI v XAH and another matter
summary: A party referred to Women's Charter provisions in force before 2025-01-02 and included multiple non-genuine or misattributed LawNet citations.
outcome: Costs order; written declaration of generative AI use required

case_name: John Coulsto et al. v Elliott
summary: Submissions asserted section 19 of the Conveyancing Act 1881 had been repealed; the court found section 19 had been reinstated by the 2013 Act.
outcome: Court rejected the submission as fallacious
